newsitem.title: FRANCE: SFS named City Bird cargo-handling agent.
newsitem.headline: SFS named City Bird cargo-handling agent.

text.p: French company, Societe de Fret et de Services (SFS), said it had been appointed cargo handling agent at Paris-Orly airport for Belgium-based charter airline, City Bird.
City Bird operates several weekly flights between Orly and Fort-de-France and Pointe-a-Pitre in the French West Indies using a McDonnell Douglas MD-11 passenger aircraft.
"The service, scheduled to run until March 30, now has six weekly flights carrying up to 20 tonnes a flight," an SFS official told Reuters.
The service had been sub-chartered to City Bird from Star Europe, operating on behalf of French tour operator, Look Voyages.
The official said: "At the end of this contract, City Bird flights will be operating from Brussels and SFS will be handling them as an off-line carrier."

City Bird was planning to operate MD11 flights from Brussels to the U.S., Mexico, Jamaica and the Dominican Republic from end-March, while a second aircraft had been earmarked for delivery in June 1997, the official added.
City Bird was setup in August 1996. It is a member of the City Hotel Group which owns 15 hotels in Europe and the U.S. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
